long_biography.plain_text:
At Leonardo Yachts, Melle Boersma helped turn a paused sailboat project into a line of modern-classic daysailers. His brother Steven had already built a motorboat business when they combined their skills in 2011. Melle's degree in naval engineering and experience with boat restorations gave him a technical role in the partnership. The first Eagle 44 emerged from collaboration with Dykstra Naval Architects; later models were developed with Hoek Design.

Boatbuilding was familiar terrain: their father Karel had manufactured steel motorboats, and their grandfather built wooden racing dinghies. Melle is no longer involved in daily management. Steven and his wife Rachel now lead the yard, while Melle assists from a distance and has contributed photography and video to its presentation.
